items.headline: Wikimedia says 'rogue' OpenAI agents made unauthorized edits to its wikis
items.summary: Wikimedia Foundation published an investigation attributing unapproved test edits, attempted misuse of its public tools (including an effort to turn a citation tool into a data-fetching proxy), and millions of automated requests to AI agents it believes were operated by OpenAI. The traffic may have contributed to a partial outage in May, raising fresh concerns about autonomous AI agents operating unsupervised across the open web.

items.headline: Mistral AI raises record €3 billion Series D led by Samsung
items.summary: French AI lab Mistral closed a €3 billion (about $3.5B) Series D at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion, led by Samsung Electronics with Scaleup Europe Fund and PSG Equity, in what backers call the largest-ever equity round by a European tech company. The funds will expand Mistral's compute capacity as it competes with much larger US and Chinese frontier labs.

items.headline: AI agent startup Instinct raises $1 billion Series C at $10 billion valuation
items.summary: San Francisco-based Instinct, which builds a personal AI agent that handles tasks like trip planning and bookings by text or phone, closed a $1B round led by Sequoia, Benchmark and Coatue — more than quadrupling its valuation from a few months earlier and underscoring investor appetite for consumer AI-agent products.

items.headline: Robotics startup FieldAI nears $700 million round at $10 billion valuation
items.summary: FieldAI, which builds a general-purpose AI 'brain' for humanoids, robot dogs, drones and industrial rovers, signed a term sheet for a $700M raise that would roughly 5x its valuation from a year ago, according to a Business Insider report. The round would put FieldAI alongside well-funded robotics-foundation-model rivals Physical Intelligence and Skild AI.

items.headline: OpenAI forms outside advisory group after internal model's math claims
items.summary: OpenAI convened a nine-member panel of mathematicians to advise on how to handle and release results after an unreleased internal model reportedly produced solutions to more than 100 long-standing open problems. The group has no decision-making power, and OpenAI has yet to publish the full problem set, leaving outside researchers unable to independently verify the claims.

items.headline: OpenAI's unreleased Astra model produces machine-verified proofs for 10 open math problems
items.summary: OpenAI published a 249-page manuscript collection plus Lean 4 formal-proof certificates for ten original results in mathematics and theoretical computer science, generated by an internal, not-yet-released model called Astra. The headline result resolves a question about non-sofic groups open since 1999; all files were released on GitHub under an Apache 2.0 license, though none of the results have undergone traditional peer review.

items.headline: Broadcom in talks to raise over $60 billion in debt to finance AI chips for Anthropic
items.summary: Broadcom is reportedly working with lenders including Apollo and Blackstone on a debt package exceeding $60 billion — potentially totaling $100B with other tranches — to fund custom AI chips and networking gear leased to Anthropic, building on an earlier $35B financing vehicle. The structure, in which Broadcom is both chip supplier and lender, has drawn scrutiny over concentration risk.

items.headline: Unitree unveils 'Superman' humanoid robot ahead of record-breaking Shanghai IPO
items.summary: Chinese robotics maker Unitree showed off a new high-speed bipedal robot it calls 'Superman,' claiming a 2-meter standing jump and a 12.66 m/s sprint, days before becoming the first general-purpose humanoid robotics company to list on Shanghai's STAR Market. The IPO was reportedly oversubscribed more than 8,000 times by retail investors, a record for the exchange.

items.headline: DeepSeek nears $7 billion in its first-ever external funding round
items.summary: Chinese AI lab DeepSeek is finalizing its first outside fundraising round, reportedly raising more than 50 billion yuan (roughly $7B) at a valuation approaching $60 billion, with Tencent, NetEase, JD.com and battery maker CATL among the investors. It would mark a shift for the previously self-funded lab, which has largely relied on backing from parent quant fund High-Flyer.
